title: Sapir's wedding
keys: Arrows / WASD: walk · Space: pick up, set down, stand up what fell · Esc: quit
how: The guests arrive in two and a half minutes. Carry tables, light poles, speakers and stage pieces from Sapir's jeep, and set each one on its mark on the lawn.
how2: Heavy things go slowly. The wind can knock over a table or a pole: run over and stand it up. On a phone, tap a pile, a mark or whatever fell.
go: Go, the guests are on their way!
noneLeft: All of those are out already
lineWin: {s} seconds to spare. Sapir switches on the lights. ({score} points)
lineLoss: Not everything is ready. Sapir will sort out the rest, but she'll remember.
